name: Big Dog K9 / Pitbull / Wolf
engine: 107 to 117 cubic inch S&S V-twin, carb or fuel injection, belt drive
intro: Big Dog's production choppers with S&S engines. Engine parts are easy; frame, wiring and bodywork parts are not.

L: Custom builders used S&S or similar engines, so most engine parts are available. Frame, bodywork and wiring parts are another matter; photograph everything before you take it apart.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
